Title: DE - 50-100
PROMPT: Companies in Germany with 50-100 employees that are actively hiring IT talent (Software Engineers, Backend Developers, DevOps Engineers, Cloud Engineers, Java/Python Developers, IT Managers, IT Specialists). Prioritize companies with IT job postings open 30+ days, hiring for Talent Acquisition Manager/IT Recruiter, same job reposted multiple times, or showing growth signals (20%+ headcount growth, Series A/B funding, new CTO/VP Engineering).
ICP Match Prompt:
Review this company's website and public information to determine if they are a good fit for People Focus, an IT recruitment agency connecting DACH companies with senior IT talent from Serbia.

Return ONLY YES or NO based on these criteria:

RETURN NO IF ANY OF THESE ARE TRUE:
1. Company is a recruitment agency, staffing firm, or headhunter (check for keywords: recruitment, staffing, headhunting, talent solutions)

4. Company has no visible software engineering or IT team
5. Company is an existing People Focus client

Tier 3: Glassdoor/Kununu reviews mentioning understaffed or slow to hire or overworked; CTO/CEO posts about hiring challenges; IT job open 90+ days.

Base your decision on information found on the company website, About Us page, Products/Services page, Careers page, and recent news.

Return only: YES or NO
